summary: Comprehensive testing of new features in Ranking Run Pró v2 - All 20 backend API tests passed (100%), Frontend UI testing verified all 10 requested features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: 92 athletes available (seeded previously + 1 test athlete created during testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features fully functional and tested.

1_social_buttons.description: Strava, WhatsApp, TikTok, YouTube buttons in profile page - all visible, enabled and functional

2_editable_fields.description: Nome, Cidade, UF, Data de Nascimento fields are editable in athlete profile with data-testid attributes

3_photo_upload.description: Photo upload input found (file input with accept=image/*), camera icon button visible on avatar

4_export_my_data.description: 'Exportar Meus Dados' button in athlete profile exports Excel file with athlete's ranking history

5_share_button_on_details.description: Compartilhar button on athlete details page opens modal with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Baixar, Copiar Link options and 9:16 image preview

6_admin_atletas_tab.description: New 'Atletas' tab in admin sidebar with CRUD operations - view, edit, delete buttons visible for each athlete

7_admin_atletas_category_filters.description: Category filter buttons: Todos, Atletas M, Atletas F, PCD M/F, Cadeirante M/F - all functional

8_admin_add_export_buttons.description: '+ Adicionar' button to create new athlete, 'Exportar Dados' button to export athletes list

9_admin_submeter_resultado_tab.description: New 'Submeter Resultado' tab with: Selecionar Atleta dropdown, Adicionar/Remover Pontos buttons, Quantidade de Pontos input, Motivo textarea, Confirmar Ajuste button

10_admin_export_ranking.description: 'Exportar CSV' and 'Exportar Excel' buttons in Rankings tab - both functional
